title: 1-Hour Distillery Tour and Tasting in Dallas
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Start off with a Welcome Water & a tasting of our ROXOR Artisan Vodka, Gin & Bourbon. See and smell the real plants used to make these artisan products in our tasting lounge, that features a Steinway Grand Piano and Contemporary Art of JM Rizzi. Next, let's relax and enjoy a Singature Cocktail. Then head back to the stills and see how these products are made. Not finished yet, as it's back to the lounge for another signature cocktail. Be sure to check out the merchandise room and get a signed bottle to take home.
